tokens.name: surface-0

tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card and dialog edges.

tokens.usage: Input borders and control outlines (3:1 on surface-0).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-0/100/200.

tokens.name: ink-muted

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, switch on, focus ring. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on surface-0/100.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, chip highlight flash, focus halo fill.

tokens.name: on-accent

tokens.name: success

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

duration.note: Motion timing. Small, close, frequent things are fast; large or far-travelling things are slower. Exits run about 70% of the enter time.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Hover, press feedback, color changes on controls.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Switch thumb, chevron rotate, chip remove, dialog exit.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Row expand, dialog enter, scrim fade, toast exit.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Toast enter, skeleton-to-content crossfade.

tokens.name: duration-shimmer
tokens.usage: One sweep of the skeleton shimmer loop.

tokens.name: stagger-step
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings entering (rows, chips). Cap the total at 150ms.

easing.note: Curves. Standard for things that move within the page, enter for things arriving, exit for things leaving.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Default: expand/collapse, switch, reorder.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, chips arriving: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: gentle start, quick finish.

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Shimmer loop and progress bars only.
